concept: VPC endpoints: Gateway for S3/DynamoDB, Interface for other services
tests: How to give private subnets private, low-cost access to S3, DynamoDB and KMS.
expected: Gateway endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB (free, via route table) + an interface endpoint (PrivateLink) for KMS — KMS has no gateway endpoint. Triggers: "privately", "minimize cost", "keep traffic off the internet", "S3, DynamoDB, KMS".
why_not: NAT gateway — traffic over the internet and data charges; an IGW in private subnets exposes them; Transit Gateway gives no native access to AWS services.
